importFolders.name: Compendium imports go into a folder per pack
importFolders.hint: An actor dragged from a compendium onto the map lands in an Actors folder named after its compendium (for example Bestiary 1), created if missing, instead of the root.

resumeOnLaunch.name: Don't start the world paused
resumeOnLaunch.hint: The server launches every world paused. When the GM opens it, resume it, unless the GM had paused it on purpose before it closed.

hideResolutionWarning.name: Hide the window-size warning
hideResolutionWarning.hint: Never show Foundry's red banner about a window smaller than 1024 x 768 or a zoom factor, for everyone in the world.

seedFromAvatar.name: Tokenizer: seed the token from the avatar
seedFromAvatar.hint: When Tokenizer opens, build the token stack from the avatar image instead of the previously saved token PNG. Stops the frame being re-applied over an already framed token every time you open the window. Wildcard tokens keep the original behaviour.

aiEnabled.name: AI image buttons
aiEnabled.hint: Show the AI button in Tokenizer's Avatar column and in item sheet headers, for anyone who owns the actor or item. Each user sets their own OpenAI key.

aiKey.name: OpenAI API key
aiKey.hint: Stored in this browser only and never sent to other connected users. Each user, players included, sets their own.

aiModel.name: OpenAI image model
aiModel.hint: For example gpt-image-1-mini, gpt-image-1, gpt-image-1.5 or gpt-image-2. Mini is the cheapest and is usually enough for a token.

aiSize.name: Image size
aiSize.hint: Square is the right shape for a token.

aiQuality.name: Image quality
aiQuality.hint: Higher quality costs more per image.

aiCampaign.name: Campaign context
aiCampaign.hint: Added before the style in every prompt to ground portraits in a shared setting. Leave empty to use the module's built-in default.

aiStyle.name: Default style prompt
aiStyle.hint: The starting style for each generation, editable per portrait in the dialog. Leave empty to use the module's built-in default.

aiIncludeName.name: Include the subject in the prompt
aiIncludeName.hint: On by default. Adds the dialog's Subject field (prefilled from the character name) to the prompt. Turn off to leave the subject out entirely. The saved file name is unaffected.

aiSaveSource.name: Save the raw generation
aiSaveSource.hint: Upload the unedited AI image to Foundry so you can reuse it later, separate from the composed avatar Tokenizer saves on submit.

aiSaveDirectory.name: Raw generation directory
aiSaveDirectory.hint: Leave empty to use Tokenizer's own upload directory for this actor type.

aiSkipDialogToken.name: Tokenizer AI: skip the dialog
aiSkipDialogToken.hint: Clicking the AI button in Tokenizer generates straight away with the defaults. Shift-click or right-click opens the dialog. Per user.

aiSkipDialogItem.name: Item AI: skip the dialog
aiSkipDialogItem.hint: Clicking the AI button on an item sheet generates straight away with the defaults. Shift-click or right-click opens the dialog. Per user.

aiItemDirectory.name: Item image directory
aiItemDirectory.hint: Where item images from the item sheet AI button are uploaded. Created if missing. Leave empty for assets/ai-items.

visionerAutoaccept.name: Visioner: auto-accept its dialogs
visionerAutoaccept.hint: When PF2e Visioner opens a preview or override-validation dialog, click Apply All for you. Hold Shift while it opens to see it. Per browser; also a toggle in the Token controls.

dropPileName.name: Dropped items: pile name
dropPileName.hint: Name of the loot actor created when an item is set to Dropped in the inventory carry menu. Lands on the nearest free square beside the owner, one pile per square; it is removed when empty.

perfMeter.name: Performance meter
perfMeter.hint: Show a small panel with FPS, frame times, long tasks, which hook was running when they happened, and what your machine is. Also a toggle in the Token controls. Use ⧉ to copy a report for the GM.

autoTreatWounds.name: Treat Wounds applies its immunity
autoTreatWounds.hint: After a Treat Wounds check, put Effect: Treat Wounds Immunity on the patient: the roll's target, or the single creature the roller had targeted. Skipped when nobody or more than one is targeted, or the patient is already immune. Runs in the GM's tab only.

autoApplyDamage.name: Damage rolls land on their target
autoApplyDamage.hint: A Strike, attack spell or blast damage roll made against one target is applied to it as the x1 button would (healing-only rolls as the heal button). Skipped when the roll has no single target (area, no target, non-attack spells), when the target saves first, when the target has a shield raised (Shield Block stays possible), and for heal-or-harm rolls. Runs in the GM's tab only.

ai.apiKeyHint: Stored in this browser only and never sent to other connected users. Each user sets their own.
ai.subjectPlaceholder: cave bear, elf child, pile of silver coins, chest mimic
ai.subjectFromToken: Name the subject from the token (off = character sheet name)
ai.detailsPlaceholder: Half-orc harbor warden, scarred jaw, oiled leather coat, holding a boat hook
ai.transparentBg: Transparent background (off = full opaque square with a plain backdrop)
ai.saveStyle: Save this style as the new default
ai.skipDialog: Skip this dialog next time (Shift-click or right-click the AI button to open it again)
ai.generating: Generating image, this takes 10 to 40 seconds...
ai.done: Portrait generated. Avatar layer added and the token rebuilt.
ai.noUpload: You do not have permission to upload files, so the image could not be saved. The GM can grant Upload New Files in Configure Permissions.
ai.noKey: No OpenAI API key set. Click the gear icon in the portrait dialog to add one.
ai.saveFailed: Portrait generated but the raw file was not saved: {error}

quickToken.noAvatar: No avatar image loaded to build the token from.

drop.noToken: This character has no token on the current scene, so the dropped item stays in the inventory.
drop.tooFar: Too far: drop it within one square of your token.

autoApply.damageFailed: Damage was not applied automatically, click the card: {error}
autoApply.immunityFailed: Treat Wounds Immunity was not applied, drag it from the card: {error}
